name: Dillr
description: Connect your Dillr kitchen to Claude so it knows what's in your pantry, who's eating, and what you've cooked before. Claude can plan meals around real constraints, save recipes to your library, build shopping lists, and update your inventory — all in one conversation. Everything Claude writes syncs instantly to the Dillr app for everyone in your household, so you can plan at your desk and cook from your phone.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dillr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dillr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dillr.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dillr MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dillr lists 23 MCP tools, including get_kitchen_context, get_cooking_history, get_guide, update_kitchen, get_inventory, update_inventory, get_occasions, update_occasions, update_leftovers, update_profile, get_recipe, and save_recipe.
Dillr requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dillr is developed by Bara Vara AB. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
